nuggets.text: Saints head coach Kellen Moore began his NFL playing career with the Lions, signing as an undrafted free agent in 2012.
Kellen Moore went 49-3 as Boise State's quarterback and was the first in FBS history to win 46 games.
Kellen Moore was a lefty QB, and after he retired the NFL had no left-handed quarterback until Tua Tagovailoa in 2020.
Kellen Moore was the Eagles' offensive coordinator when they beat the Chiefs 40-22 in Super Bowl LIX.
The Saints and Lions are dead even all-time at 13-13-1.
Tom Dempsey, born without toes on his kicking foot, hit a then-record 63-yard field goal to beat the Lions in 1970.
The archbishop of New Orleans approved the Saints' name, joking the team would need all the help it could get.
New Saints running back Travis Etienne, from Jennings, Louisiana, pronounces his last name AY-chan.
Alvin Kamara tied an NFL record with six rushing touchdowns against the Vikings on Christmas Day 2020.
The Superdome's original artificial turf was called "Mardi Grass."
